== Summary ==
Slip “•Palpatine, Galactic Emperor” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (594, 1105, 1106, 1827)). Version [[Palpatine, Galactic Emperor]] (Original). Not a recreation.
